title: Effects of administration route on uptake kinetics of 18F-sodium fluoride Positron Emission Tomography in mice
protocol: Prepare <sup>18</sup>F-NaF in saline (0.9% w/v).
Use a cyclotron and a FASTlab synthesiser (GE Healthcare), using commercially available cassettes.
Induce and maintain anaesthesia using isoflurane (2-2.5%, Oxygen 0.5 L/min, Nitrous Oxide 0.5 L/min) during the whole surgical procedure.
Insert polyethylene catheters (PE10) filled with heparinized (20 IU/mL) saline into the left femoral artery or vein using a stereomicroscope.
Secure fastened catheters with ligatures (6-0 silk thread).
Hold catheters in place with surgical glue.
Transfer animals to the PET/CT scanner (nanoPET/CT, Mediso, Hungary) for all subsequent imaging procedures.
Use the right femur and the right tibia to obtain bone measurements.
Administer <sup>18</sup>F-NaF via intra-vascular or intra-peritoneal injection.
Obtain a 60 min whole-body emission scan immediately post-radiotracer administration using a 1:5 coincidence mode.
Acquire a CT scan for attenuation correction with semi-circular full trajectory, maximum field of view, 360 projections, 35 kVp, 170 ms and 1:4 binning.

Reconstruct PET data into frames of 6×30 sec, 3×60 sec, 2×120 sec, and 10×300 sec using Mediso’s iterative Tera-Tomo 3D reconstruction algorithm with settings including 4 iterations, 6 subsets, full detector model, low regularisation, spike filter on, voxel size 0.4 mm and 400-600 keV energy window.
Correct PET data for randoms, scatter, and attenuation.
Import reconstructed scans into PMOD 4.0 software (PMOD Technologies, Switzerland).
Manually draw volumes of interest (VOIs) around organs and bones of interest using the CT data.
Estimate radioactivity in the blood using the blood pool in the vena cava.
Generate time-active curves (TACs) for each organ.
Calculate standardised uptake values (SUV, g/ml) using the given equation.
Perform kinetic modelling using Patlak analysis (t*=16minutes) to estimate the influx constant (Ki).
Use the blood pool VOI in the vena cava as reference tissue VOI for Patlak modelling.
Take SUV and SUVr averages from the last 3 frames between 45-60 minutes.
